name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Bloomerang's onboarding team owns the moment that decides whether a customer actually gets value from the platform, and that's the exact job I've already done. At Wix, I directly managed a team of onboarding specialists for two years, a team of 20, later 8, while personally onboarding 25+ clients a month and holding 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets. Getting a team to deliver a consistent, high-quality onboarding experience at volume is the specific problem this role is built to solve, and it's the one I've solved before.

Coaching and developing people while staying accountable for outcomes is something I've done and had corroborated: my former manager at Wix wrote that I was the first to lead team initiatives and helped develop sales training for tenured account executives. At Birdeye, I led onboarding and training for a partner network and built the communication workflows that reduced onboarding friction, then partnered directly with Product and Engineering to keep customer feedback flowing into the roadmap, the same cross-functional connective tissue this role asks for.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that experience maps to what Bloomerang needs from this role. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
